coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first; its newest items remained the 2026-10-05 rescissions for Compassionate Care Angels LLC and O.M.K Healthcare Services LLC, both already observed and treated as duplicates. Twelve additional targeted searches covered hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural emergency service loss, ambulance, air-medical, restoration/reopening, and U.S. territories. No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access development was identified in the observation window. Stale events, proposals without concrete access effect, non-U.S. events, unsupported or irrelevant results, and duplicate prior findings were excluded.
